index.showcase.title: More than meal planning
index.showcase.subtitle: From the first idea to the last bite, Forkcast has a view for it.
index.showcase.1.title: Cook with a guided view
index.showcase.1.desc: Step-by-step instructions, timers, and exact ingredient amounts laid out so you can cook without scrolling back and forth.

index.why.title: Why Forkcast
index.why.subtitle: Real food data, no strings attached.
index.why.1.title: Powered by Spoonacular
index.why.1.desc: Access to 5,000+ recipes with detailed ingredients and nutrition, straight from the Spoonacular database.
index.why.2.title: Free & open source
index.why.2.desc: No ads, no paywalls. Forkcast is free to use and its full source code is public on GitHub.
index.why.3.title: Speaks your language
index.why.3.desc: A fully localized interface in nine languages, including right-to-left support.
index.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
index.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
index.faq.1.a: Yes. Forkcast is free to use, with no credit card required to sign up.
index.faq.2.q: Do I need to install anything?
index.faq.2.a: No. Forkcast runs in your browser on any device — desktop, tablet, or phone.
index.faq.3.q: Can I plan meals for my whole family?
index.faq.3.a: Absolutely. Plan as many meals as you like across your week and generate one combined shopping list.
index.faq.4.a: Forkcast is available in nine languages, including English, German, Spanish, French, and more.
index.faq.5.a: Create a free account, browse the recipe library, and drag your first meal onto the calendar.
